properties.title: Valid Input Format Required
properties.natural_language: BLS precompile execution REQUIRES input calldata to be decodable according to the specific operation's expected format before any cryptographic computation
properties.formal_spec: PRE(execute_bls_precompile): input != null AND decodable(input, operation_type)
properties.rationale: Invalid or malformed input cannot be processed; early rejection prevents wasted computation

properties.title: Validation Before Cryptographic Execution
properties.natural_language: Cryptographic operations MUST ONLY execute after ALL input validation checks pass (field encoding, curve membership, subgroup membership)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL bls_call: execute_crypto_op(bls_call) IMPLIES validation_passed(bls_call)
properties.rationale: Executing crypto on invalid inputs could produce undefined results or enable attacks

properties.title: Validation Failure Burns All Gas
properties.natural_language: WHEN any BLS validation check fails, the precompile MUST consume ALL supplied gas and return an error
properties.formal_spec: FORALL bls_call: validation_failed(bls_call) => gas_consumed == gas_supplied AND result == ERROR
properties.rationale: Gas burning prevents attackers from probing validation for free

properties.title: Successful Execution Returns Encoded Output
properties.natural_language: WHEN BLS precompile execution succeeds, THEN output data MUST be correctly encoded according to the operation's output format
properties.formal_spec: POST(execute_bls_precompile): success => output == encode(result) AND length(output) == expected_output_length
properties.rationale: Correctly formatted output is essential for callers to interpret results

properties.title: Input Length Validation First
properties.natural_language: BLS input validation MUST check input length BEFORE attempting any field element or point validation
properties.formal_spec: PRE(validate_field_elements): length_check_passed == true
properties.rationale: Length validation prevents out-of-bounds reads during field parsing

properties.title: Fp Element Encoding Constraint
properties.natural_language: EVERY Fp field element MUST have its top 16 bytes equal to zero AND its value strictly less than the field modulus p
properties.formal_spec: FORALL fp in input_fp_elements: fp[0:16] == 0x00...00 AND to_integer(fp[16:64]) < FIELD_MODULUS_P
properties.rationale: Non-canonical encodings could lead to implementation divergence or security issues

properties.title: Point Must Satisfy Curve Equation
properties.natural_language: ALL non-infinity G1/G2 points MUST satisfy the curve equation y^2 = x^3 + b (or twisted curve for G2)
properties.formal_spec: FORALL point in input_points: is_infinity(point) OR curve_equation_satisfied(point)
properties.rationale: Points not on curve would produce cryptographically invalid results

properties.title: Subgroup Check for MSM and Pairing
properties.natural_language: FOR MSM and pairing operations, ALL input points MUST be verified to lie in the correct prime-order subgroup
properties.formal_spec: FORALL point in (msm_inputs UNION pairing_inputs): subgroup_check(point) == true
properties.rationale: Non-subgroup points enable small subgroup attacks that break cryptographic security

properties.title: Empty Input Rejected for Variable Operations
properties.natural_language: WHEN MSM or pairing receives empty input (k=0), THEN the operation MUST fail with an error
properties.formal_spec: POST(validate_msm_input): input_count == 0 => state == STATE-INPUT-EMPTY
properties.rationale: Empty input produces undefined behavior; explicit rejection ensures determinism

properties.title: Gas Context Required for Calculation
properties.natural_language: Gas calculation REQUIRES knowledge of available gas and input size before operation execution
properties.formal_spec: PRE(calculate_bls_gas): available_gas != null AND input_size != null
properties.rationale: Cannot determine if execution is possible without gas context

properties.title: Fixed Cost Operations Use Constant Gas
properties.natural_language: G1ADD (375), G2ADD (600), MAP_FP_TO_G1 (5500), and MAP_FP2_TO_G2 (23800) MUST have fixed gas costs regardless of input
properties.formal_spec: gas_cost(G1ADD) == 375 AND gas_cost(G2ADD) == 600 AND gas_cost(MAP_FP) == 5500 AND gas_cost(MAP_FP2) == 23800
properties.rationale: Fixed cost operations must have deterministic gas pricing for consensus

properties.title: MSM Discount Factor Bounded
properties.natural_language: The MSM discount factor MUST be within range [519, 1000] based on input count k, decreasing as k increases
properties.formal_spec: FORALL k >= 1: discount(k) >= 519 AND discount(k) <= 1000 AND (k1 > k2 => discount(k1) <= discount(k2))
properties.rationale: Discount bounds ensure gas cost is proportional to computation while incentivizing batching

properties.title: Insufficient Gas Blocks Execution
properties.natural_language: WHEN calculated gas cost exceeds available gas, THEN execution MUST NOT proceed
properties.formal_spec: POST(deduct_gas): gas_cost > available_gas => state == STATE-OUT-OF-GAS AND execution_blocked
properties.rationale: Gas metering prevents unbounded computation

properties.title: Untrusted Input Sanitization Required
properties.natural_language: ALL input from smart contracts MUST pass through validation before being used in cryptographic operations
properties.formal_spec: FORALL input from EXT-SMART-CONTRACT: used_in_crypto(input) IMPLIES sanitized(input)
properties.rationale: Security boundary enforcement - untrusted input must be validated

properties.title: G1ADD/G2ADD Explicitly Skip Subgroup Check
properties.natural_language: G1ADD and G2ADD operations MUST NOT perform subgroup membership checks, accepting any on-curve point
properties.formal_spec: FORALL add_op in {G1ADD, G2ADD}: NOT(requires_subgroup_check(add_op))
properties.rationale: Design decision - ADD operations explicitly skip subgroup check for performance; applications must handle

properties.title: Gas Limits Prevent DoS
properties.natural_language: ALL BLS operations MUST be bounded by gas limits, preventing unlimited computation
properties.formal_spec: FORALL bls_op: computation_time(bls_op) <= f(gas_supplied(bls_op))
properties.rationale: DoS protection through resource bounding

properties.title: Fork State Required for Gas Pricing
properties.natural_language: Gas cost calculation REQUIRES knowledge of whether current block is pre- or post-Tangerine Whistle fork
properties.formal_spec: PRE(calculate_opcode_gas): block_number != null AND tangerine_fork_block != null
properties.rationale: Correct gas pricing depends on fork state

properties.title: Post-Tangerine Gas Costs Increased
properties.natural_language: AFTER block 2,463,000, IO-heavy opcodes MUST use increased gas costs: EXTCODESIZE (700), BALANCE (400), SLOAD (200), CALL (700)
properties.formal_spec: block >= 2463000 => gas(EXTCODESIZE) == 700 AND gas(BALANCE) == 400 AND gas(SLOAD) == 200 AND gas(CALL) == 700
properties.rationale: Gas repricing mitigates DoS attacks exploiting underpriced IO operations

properties.title: SELFDESTRUCT Base Cost Post-Fork
properties.natural_language: AFTER Tangerine Whistle, SELFDESTRUCT base cost MUST be 5000 gas, with additional 25000 for new account creation
properties.formal_spec: block >= 2463000 => gas_base(SELFDESTRUCT) == 5000 AND gas_new_account(SELFDESTRUCT) == 25000
properties.rationale: Prevents state bloat attacks through mass account creation via SELFDESTRUCT

properties.title: 63/64 Gas Allocation Rule
properties.natural_language: Child call frames MUST receive at most (gas - gas/64) of available gas, retaining 1/64 for parent
properties.formal_spec: max_child_gas = gas - (gas // 64) AND child_gas <= max_child_gas
properties.rationale: Ensures parent retains gas for post-call processing; prevents call-depth attacks

properties.title: Insufficient Extra Gas Throws OOG
properties.natural_language: WHEN available gas is less than extra_gas required for call, THEN OUT_OF_GAS exception MUST be thrown
properties.formal_spec: POST(check_gas): gas < extra_gas => state == STATE-OUT-OF-GAS
properties.rationale: Prevents execution without sufficient overhead gas

properties.title: New Account Penalty Applied
properties.natural_language: SELFDESTRUCT with non-existent beneficiary MUST charge additional 25000 gas penalty
properties.formal_spec: FORALL selfdestruct: NOT(account_exists(beneficiary)) => gas_cost >= 5000 + 25000
properties.rationale: Discourages state bloat through mass account creation

properties.title: SELFDESTRUCT Transfers and Marks Deletion
properties.natural_language: AFTER SELFDESTRUCT gas is paid, balance MUST be transferred to beneficiary AND contract MUST be marked for deletion
properties.formal_spec: POST(selfdestruct): beneficiary_balance_after == beneficiary_balance_before + contract_balance AND contract_marked_for_deletion
properties.rationale: Complete SELFDESTRUCT semantics require both transfer and deletion marking

properties.title: Valid Batch Submission Required
properties.natural_language: Batch execution REQUIRES a properly formatted wallet_sendCalls request with calls array and optional flow control
properties.formal_spec: PRE(submit_batch): calls != null AND length(calls) > 0
properties.rationale: Empty or null batch cannot be executed

properties.title: Batch Status Code Semantics
properties.natural_language: Batch status codes MUST accurately reflect execution state: 100 (pending), 102 (partial), 200 (confirmed), 207 (partial success), 500 (rollback fail), 600 (halt fail)
properties.formal_spec: status_code == 100 IFF no_calls_onchain AND status_code == 200 IFF all_calls_succeeded AND status_code == 500 IFF rollback_triggered
properties.rationale: Correct status reporting is essential for dApp state management

properties.title: Strict Atomicity Survives Reorgs
properties.natural_language: IN strict atomicity mode, batch calls MUST remain atomic even during blockchain reorganizations
properties.formal_spec: atomicity == STRICT => FORALL reorg: calls_remain_atomic(batch, reorg)
properties.rationale: Strongest atomicity guarantee requires reorg-resistant execution

properties.title: None Atomicity Maintains Order
properties.natural_language: IN no-atomicity mode, calls MUST still execute in order but MAY have other transactions interleaved
properties.formal_spec: atomicity == NONE => FORALL i < j: call_i.included_block <= call_j.included_block OR (same_block AND call_i.position < call_j.position)
properties.rationale: Order guarantee is minimum requirement even without atomicity

properties.title: Unsupported Atomicity Rejected
properties.natural_language: WHEN wallet cannot provide requested atomicity level, THEN request MUST be rejected with UNSUPPORTED_LEVEL error
properties.formal_spec: POST(check_atomicity): NOT(wallet_supports(requested_level)) => state == STATE-ATOMICITY-REJECTED
properties.rationale: Explicit rejection prevents silent degradation of atomicity guarantees

properties.title: Rollback Mode Reverts All
properties.natural_language: WHEN a call with onFailure=rollback fails, ALL previously executed calls in the batch MUST be reverted
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call with onFailure == ROLLBACK: call.failed => FORALL prev_call: prev_call.reverted
properties.rationale: Rollback semantics require complete state reversion

properties.title: Halt Mode Preserves Earlier Calls
properties.natural_language: WHEN a call with onFailure=halt fails, earlier executed calls MUST remain committed but subsequent calls MUST NOT execute
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call_i with onFailure == HALT AND call_i.failed: (FORALL call_j where j < i: call_j.committed) AND (FORALL call_k where k > i: NOT(call_k.executed))
properties.rationale: Halt semantics preserve partial progress while stopping on failure

properties.title: Continue Mode Proceeds Despite Failure
properties.natural_language: WHEN a call with onFailure=continue fails, subsequent calls MUST still be executed
properties.formal_spec: FORALL call_i with onFailure == CONTINUE AND call_i.failed: FORALL call_j where j > i: call_j.attempted
properties.rationale: Continue semantics allow partial success with failure tolerance

properties.title: Rollback Incompatible with None Atomicity
properties.natural_language: Requests specifying onFailure=rollback with atomicity=none MUST be rejected as invalid
properties.formal_spec: FORALL request: (has_rollback_call(request) AND atomicity(request) == NONE) => rejected(request)
properties.rationale: Rollback is semantically impossible without atomicity guarantees

properties.title: Call-Scope Requires Batch-Scope
properties.natural_language: WHEN flow control is specified at call scope, THEN batch-scope capability MUST also be present
properties.formal_spec: POST(validate_capability): has_call_scope_capability AND NOT(has_batch_scope_capability) => state == STATE-ERROR-MISSING-CAP
properties.rationale: Call-scope depends on batch-scope capability being established first
